title: クラシックに向けた記者会見

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, a press conference is held for the first race of the Classics—the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wow! Look at all those reporters! Hehe, I must really be amazing, huh?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Many people are keeping tabs on your progress. How are you feeling about the Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm totally ready to win it, of course!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm aiming to be the best racer ever, which means I gotta be number one among my peers first!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Who would you consider your biggest rival?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Rival? Isn't that obvious? It's the student council president, Symboli Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: When it comes to the Classics, Prez is famous for being a Triple Crown champion, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So the Satsuki Sho is just the beginning. I need to win the Derby and the Kikuka Sho too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Then I'll be a Triple Crown champion, just like Prez!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Wow!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: All the reporters seemed pretty excited! I didn't realize how much of a big shot I am these days!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But now my heart won't stop pounding! The Classics are already here!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I said I'm gonna be Triple Crown champion, so I gotta train even harder than before!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm on it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …By the way, I have an idea. Do you have a minute?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Remember when I did that partner run with Air Groove? I want to incorporate more of those into my training!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Only with veteran runners, though! The stronger, the better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If there's one thing I learned from our experience with Air Groove, it's that Teio can gain a lot from training with such seasoned racers.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd agree!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Okay. Then I'll go find some people to race against!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… You're so fast, Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I could say the same for you—it's impressive how well you're keeping up, seeing as you're still in your classic year.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe! You know it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well, don't you two make an odd couple. The heck are ya doing?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tamamo! Perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You gotta race me too! C'mon, over here! Get into starting position!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? Now hold on just a sec! The heck are ya talkin' about?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio continues to hone her skills for the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm mulling over her progress while watching her train, when…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Teio certainly seems pumped to take on the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: She's done a fine job of improving her abilities since her debut.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yes… It is a far cry from when she forgot herself and was merely obsessed with blind longing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Where she was once a mere spectator clapping along, she has now climbed down onto the turf, chasing after me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And she says she's planning on becoming a Triple Crown champion too. Hehe… She truly has come quite far.
choice_data_list: You've got your eye on her.
You've got your eye on her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I suppose so…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I have long made it my mission to create a world where all Umamusume can achieve true happiness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: At first, I kept watch out of concern that she may choose to live in my shadow, rather than pursue the true pinnacle that all racers should seek.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But now…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "I'm going to become the king of kings, a Monarch to surpass even the almighty Emperor!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: When Teio proclaimed that to me—when I saw that burning ferocity in her eyes—a flame was lit in my own heart.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: A flame that burns strong even now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As the Emperor, I wish for her happiness. But under the veil… deep down…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I've been waiting… for someone like Teio.
choice_data_list: I'll make sure she surpasses you.
I'll make sure she surpasses you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha… Well, be sure I'll put up quite a fight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf awaits on the highest of peaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Tokai Teio will break through the Classics and follow her no matter what may lie ahead!
